reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism involves a photonics-based W-band ISAC system that utilizes a combination of communication and radar sensing signals. The ISAC coupling mode is based on a time-division multiplexing (TDM) approach, where the communication and sensing signals are multiplexed in time and sent in different time slots. The system uses a probabilistic shaping (PS) single-carrier modulation (SCM) to flexibly adjust the transmitting entropy and maximize the usage of the available capacity. The sensing signal is an LFM signal that is used to actively detect the location of the users. The system also uses a servo turntable to scan the area, find the users, and send data to the users at the highest available rate.
